name: T3rmx UserBot
description: T3rmx UserBot is an independent, modular Telegram automation framework built with Python, designed for extensibility, reliability, security, and advanced Telegram MTProto interactions.

APP_ID.description: Telegram API ID from https://my.telegram.org (API_ID also accepted)

STRING_SESSION.description: Telethon string session for the user account

TG_BOT_USERNAME.description: Assistant bot username (with or without @). Normalized internally.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL database URL for persistent data (strongly recommended for Railway/production; SQLite fallback is not durable on ephemeral filesystems)

VCMODE.description: Enable T3rmx-VC integration intent (requires verified backend for call control)

VC_SESSION.description: Optional VC session (if used by a verified backend)

T3RMX_OWNER_ID.description: Telegram user ID of the deployment owner (authorized for privileged commands). Set this to YOUR Telegram ID.

OWNER_ID.description: Alias for T3RMX_OWNER_ID (deployment owner Telegram user ID). Optional if T3RMX_OWNER_ID is set.

PRIVATE_GROUP_BOT_API_ID.description: Optional: bot log group/channel ID for internal logs
